summary.zh-CN: 修复可移植 Service App 的跨平台运行器打包与 Unix 执行权限，发布验证现在会实际调用内置应用。
summary.en-US: Fix cross-platform runner packaging and Unix permissions for Portable Service Apps, with a real included-app call in published validation.

title.zh-CN: 可移植 Service App 可正常启动

body.zh-CN: Stable Runtime 会为 Linux x64、Windows x64 和 macOS arm64/x64 打包对应运行器并保留执行权限；缺少运行器时发布会直接失败。
body.en-US: Stable Runtime releases package the correct runner for Linux x64, Windows x64, and macOS arm64/x64 while preserving executable permissions; publishing fails if a runner is missing.

title.zh-CN: 发布前验证真实应用调用
title.en-US: Real app invocation in release validation

body.zh-CN: 公开产物验证会检查安装后的运行器并实际调用一次内置可移植 Service App，避免只验证更新版本号。
body.en-US: Published-artifact validation checks the installed runner and invokes an included Portable Service App instead of validating only the updated version.
